                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          বিকল্প 4) NR - LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          সুতরাং, সমস্ত বিকল্পের মধ্যে, 'LP - JK' হল ভিন্ন।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          অতএব, \"বিকল্প 1\" হল সঠিক উত্তর।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n2a2:T6de,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          અહીં અનુસરવામાં આવેલો તર્ક છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          વિકલ્પ 1) LP - JK

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          વિકલ્પ 2) JN - HL

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          વિકલ્પ 3) OS - MQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          વિકલ્પ 4) NR - LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          આમ, બધા વિકલ્પોમાંથી, 'LP - JK' વિષમ છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          તેથી, \"વિકલ્પ 1\" સાચો જવાબ છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n2a3:T704,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾದ ತರ್ಕವೆಂದರೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಆಯ್ಕೆ 1) LP - JK

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಆಯ್ಕೆ 2) JN - HL

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          இங்கு பின்பற்றப்படும் தர்க்கம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          விருப்பம் 1) LP - JK

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          விருப்பம் 2) JN - HL

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          விருப்பம் 3) OS - MQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          விருப்பம் 4) NR - LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          எனவே, கொடுக்கப்பட்ட அனைத்து விருப்பங்களிலும், 'LP - JK' என்பது முரண்பட்டது.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ஆகவே, \"விருப்பம் 1\" சரியான பதில்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n2a5:T9f7,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଏଠାରେ ଅନୁସରଣ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ତର୍କଟି ହେଉଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n<", "or": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଏଠାରେ ଅନୁସରଣ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ତର୍କଟି ହେଉଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବିକଳ୍ପ 1) LP - JK

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବିକଳ୍ପ 2) JN - HL

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବିକଳ୍ପ 3) OS - MQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ବିକଳ୍ପ 4) NR - LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଏହିପରି, ସମସ୍ତ ବିକଳ୍ପ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ, ' LP - JK ' ହେଉଛି ଅସଙ୍ଗତ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ତେଣୁ, \"ବିକଳ୍ପ 1\" ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n2a6:T6e5,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਇੱਥੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਤਰਕ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਵਿਕਲਪ 1) LP - JK

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਵਿਕਲਪ 2) JN - HL

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਵਿਕਲਪ 3) OS - MQ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਵਿਕਲਪ 4) NR - LP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ, ਸਾਰੇ ਵਿਕਲਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ, 'LP - JK' ਵੱਖਰਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਇਸ ਲਈ, \"ਵਿਕਲਪ 1\" ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n2a7:Te8f,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Northbridge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Northbridge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Northbridge is a chipset on the motherboard that acts as the primary interface between the CPU and high-speed components like RAM and GPUs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It facilitates high-speed communication between the CPU and the system's memory (RAM), as well as graphics controllers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In modern systems, the Northbridge is often integrated directly into the CPU itself, enhancing efficiency and reducing latency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It plays a critical role in ensuring smooth data transfer between the CPU and other high-performance components.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Over time, the Northbridge has become less distinct as newer technologies like System-on-Chip (SoC) designs integrate its functions directly into the processor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Chipset Architecture\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A motherboard's chipset typically consists of two main components: the Northbridge and the Southbridge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Northbridge handles high-speed communication with the CPU, RAM, and GPU, while the Southbridge manages peripheral devices like I/O ports and storage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Modern Replacements\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In modern motherboards, the Northbridge's functions are integrated into the CPU die, eliminating the need for a separate chipset.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This integration is commonly seen in Intel's Core series processors and AMD's Ryzen processors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
